title: Normalized closed-test scalar and actual-map model diagrams
statement: Use commutative condensed coefficients $c:R\to S$, exact scalar restriction $r$, evaluation $E_W$, computation units $\alpha$, forward comparisons $\delta,\gamma$ and ordinary unit sections [def-sfb-closed-test-scalar-comparison-maps], and the coefficient/pullback comparisons $\theta$ [sk-def-sfb-coefficient-comparisons]. Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $\mathfrak a$ an ideal, $s:Z=\operatorname{Spec}(A/\mathfrak a)\to U=\operatorname{Spec}A$, $f:X\to U$, and $X_Z$ a specified cartesian pullback with projections $h,f_Z$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $V$ be an affine pro-etale object of $Z$, $B$ its affine closed-site lift [def-exc-closed-site-lift], $T=X\times_UB$, $T_0=X_Z\times_ZV$, and $a:T_0\to T$ the canonical closed test arrow. Use the recorded evaluation, closed-unit complex, pushforward representative, exact representative, pullback representative and degreewise localization model [lem-sfb-closed-test-kinjective-section-models]. For $K$ in the ordinary derived category define TestModel$(R,h,K)$ to consist of a K-injective complex $I$, an isomorphism $e:QI\cong K$, a K-injective complex $J$, and a quasi-isomorphism $j:h_R^*I\to J$. Put $e_h:QJ\cong h_R^*K$ equal to the recorded exact pullback representative. Define $r_{I,J}=Q(j(T_0)\eta_a):QI(T)\to QJ(T_0)$, with $\eta_a$ the actual section unit. Define $\sigma_I:QI(T)\to RE_{R,V}(s_R^*Rf_{*,R}K)$ as $Q$ of the closed unit on $f_*I$, followed by the computation unit and the image of its exact pushforward representative; thus its inverse, when invertible, uses the actual closed-unit inverse. Define $\tau_J:QJ(T_0)\to RE_{R,V}(Rf_{Z*,R}h_R^*K)$ by the computation unit and pushforward representative. Write $\ell_I,\ell_J$ for the recorded localization models, defined by the literal degreewise section identity. For $e:QI\cong N$, a K-injective $P$ with $d:QP\cong rN$, define $C_W(I,P)=\alpha_{S,W,I};RE_{S,W}e;\gamma_{W,N};RE_{R,W}d^{-1};\alpha_{R,W,P}^{-1}$. Define $C_0$ similarly on $J$ using $e_h$ and $\theta_h$. Define $C_s$ and $C_t$ on source and target derived sections as forward $\gamma$ followed respectively by $\theta_s;s_R^*\delta_f$ and $\delta_{f_Z};Rf_{Z*,R}\theta_h$. Define $C_{\mathrm{loc},W}=\gamma_{\mathrm{id}_W};RE_{R,\mathrm{id}_W}\theta_W$. Define ModelCoherence$(c,A,\mathfrak a,f,h,f_Z,V,N,I,J,P)$ to be invertibility of the two $\sigma$, two $\tau$, and four localization-model arrows, together with $C_T;\sigma_R=\sigma_S;C_s$, $C_0;\tau_R=\tau_S;C_t$, $r_{I,J};C_0=C_T;r_{P,J_P}$, $C_T;\ell_P=\ell_I;C_{\mathrm{loc},T}$ and $C_0;\ell_{J_P}=\ell_J;C_{\mathrm{loc},T_0};R\Gamma_{\mathrm{loc}}\theta_h$. For an actual derived arrow $\beta:K\to L$, define its section-model map $m_W=\alpha_{R,W,I};RE_{R,W}(e\beta d^{-1});\alpha_{R,W,P}^{-1}$ for a K-injective target model $P$. Define ModelMapCoherence to be the five naturality squares for $\sigma$, $\tau$, $r_{I,J}$, $\ell_I$ and $\ell_J$ with these model maps and the corresponding actual derived image of $\beta$. For an actual $\beta:K\to rN$, define MapCoherence to be naturality of $Ru_{h,a}$ for $\beta$, together with $Ru^S_{h,a};\gamma_{T_0};RE_{R,T_0}\theta_h=\gamma_T;Ru^R_{h,a}$. Each predicate is a conjunction of the displayed equalities in $D(\operatorname{Ab})$; defining it asserts none of them, imposes no coherence assumption on TestModel, and makes no choice of resolutions.

reviewed_lean.note: Mathematics correct: delta=restrictPush and gamma are forward rightDerivedPullback comparisons, never inverted. UniversalCoherence (normalization, unit, counit, compositor, exchange square), SectionCoherence (gamma normalization, unit-section and derived squares, direct-image section identity), ModelCoherence (8 IsIso + source/target/chain/2 localization squares, sourceModel = eUnit.inv≫eLeft.inv of the landed section-models lemma), Map/ModelMapCoherence for every actual K→Res N on D^+, scalarUnit = ordinary m↦1⊗m. Edge cases c=id, 𝔞=0, 𝔞=A, Λ'=0, non-flat ℤ→ℤ/2 OK; no extra hypotheses; H5/H6/H8 OK.
